QUOTE: Set `MBEDTLS_PLATFORM_MEMORY` in the project's config header ... "Treat the standard-function default as inferred from the platform header, not as verified from the shipped config."
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The answer names MBEDTLS_PLATFORM_MEMORY as a switch but never says it is commented out in the shipped mbedtls_config.h, and it disclaims having checked the shipped config.
